title: Canonical Method
description: research_pipeline_v2.2 P4_METHOD_PILOT output. A named, parameterized variant of a generic canonical_behavior, taken verbatim from a source book. NOT crypto-adapted; source-native terminology preserved. No profitability/edge/validated-performance claims are made.

parent_behavior_id.description: Must be one of the 21 canonical_behavior_id values in registry/p4_b1_partial.json. This task does NOT propose new generic behaviors.

method_class.description: Lossless roll-up class (P4 v2.2 ADIM 1b KURAL 2). Enables grouping granularity back up without reprocessing.

method_name_in_source.description: The proper name as it literally appears in the source text (e.g. 'RSI BAMM', 'Gartley', 'AB=CD'). Must be SOURCE_EXPLICIT.

distinguishing_parameters.description: Every entry must carry page OR claim_ref. If neither is present in the source record, the parameter is omitted rather than invented.

evidence_label.description: Constrained to the V8_CONSTITUTION label set. This task always uses LITERATURE_SUPPORTED.
